title: ＩＣＴ入門
subtitle: Introduction to ICT
courseType: Design Project ProgramDesign Project CoursesDesign Project
educationalGoal: Understand the mechanics of personal computers and their capabilities and possibilities. On top of that, students will acquire the basic ability to utilize personal computers as students and members of society for purposes such as education, research, and technological development. In particular, students will acquire the ability to create documents and presentation materials.
advice:
In this course, you will learn the following basics of using your personal computer (laptop computer) for study and student life.
1. Basic PC skills: Learn basic operations such as using Windows and software installation.
2. Networks: Learn how to set up connections to on-campus and off-campus networks, how to view on-campus and off-campus web pages, how to use the on-campus web systems, learn about network security and anti-virus software, and learn the proper behaviors when using networks.
3. MS Office software: Learn basic skills in document creation and presentation material creation.

The 1st and 2nd class sessions will be held during the orientation period. Guidance will be provided during the  3rd class session. From the 4th to the 8th class sessions, quizzes using video materials and the e-syllabus will be available. Students who complete the quiz (scoring full marks) by the day before the class session will be exempt from attending the face-to-face class for that session only.
There are 8 class sessions. Missing 3 or more sessions will result in failure (due to poor attendance).
Pass/fail is determined by the final report. Only students who pass all quizzes from sessions 4 through 8 will be permitted to begin work on the final report.
books: Introduction to ICT/Introduction to Data Sciense 2026(Kanazawa Institute of Technology)
requiredKnowledge: No prior knowledge or skills are assumed. The exercises will be done on your own laptop computer. Be sure to bring your laptop computer, power adapter, and network cable (LAN cable) to each class.

activityGoals.body: To be able to understand the basics of personal computers and the usage of laptop computers.
To be able to understand the basics of Windows and to use Windows and applications that run on Windows.
To be able to understand how to install software and make your PC available for use at our university.
To be able to understand the mechanism of virus infection and protect your computer from computer viruses.
To be able to set your network settings and use the campus network.
To be able to operate MS Office software and make effective use of data.
